findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Fixed 16-way hash sharding no longer guarantees the workflow's hard per-shard transport limit as retained packet history grows.
findings.capa_direction: Increase deterministic transport fan-out or otherwise bound shard size without changing packet semantics, then prove exact semantic equivalence and successful current publication.

capa.implementation: Expand deterministic Watch runtime transport from 16 to 32 hash shards while keeping the 2,000,000-byte per-shard guard unchanged.

evidence.failed_step: Initialize W10 same-snapshot lineage and bind persisted Phase 2

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Decision Watch Integration is triggered by completion of any one of several upstream workflows instead of first checking that the persisted required artifacts are ready for the same current snapshot.
findings.capa_direction: Add a fail-success readiness gate so premature triggers exit cleanly without running integration; retain strict W10 same-snapshot validation.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Symbol-view publishing is triggered by Elliott shadow completion as well as runtime publication; when runtime is still stale, the build correctly fails but creates avoidable operational failures.
findings.capa_direction: Add a current-runtime readiness gate for Elliott-triggered refreshes or narrow the trigger while preserving the ability to refresh read-only Elliott display.

findings.root_cause: The QM-J runner retained an obsolete hard-coded archive filename after the canonical Decision evidence archive moved to the compressed .jsonl.gz path.

capa.implementation: Use current_evidence.DEFAULT_ARCHIVE in the QM-J runner and monitor the canonical .jsonl.gz archive in its workflow.

static_risks_to_verify.description: Scanner publication uses a direct git push after a long build and does not currently have the explicit main-advanced refusal guard used by Decision Watch publication.
static_risks_to_verify.safety_expectation: A rejected push must not publish the autorun marker remotely; a later retry must remain eligible.
